confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from aggregated Cardiff cost-of-living figures (Expatica/Numbeo-style averages, June 2026 snapshot) and UK-wide 2026 pub and cocktail surveys, with Cardiff pricing assumed close to the UK average. Cocktail and wine anchors are weaker: the cocktail figure is a 2025 DesignMyNight average and the wine figure is a January 2025 175ml average uplifted for 2026, and no 2026 Cardiff wine or cocktail survey was found. Restaurant meal anchors are less certain because the sources are crowd-sourced. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of mid-sized UK cities; live booking pages were not inspected. GBP-to-USD conversion used an assumed rate of about 1.30 USD per GBP, which was not verified by search. FX: the only RBA exchange-rate page retrieved showed 0.7088 as at 20 March 2026, so this is not the latest observation. A later 18 November 2026 figure of 0.6720 appeared only in a third-party source citing the RBA and could not be confirmed on rba.gov.au, so it is not used here. Treat the FX field as stale and re-verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Cardiff is priced against UK national survey averages for pints, cocktails and wine, and against Cardiff-specific aggregated restaurant and café averages. Accommodation is based on comparable mid-sized UK cities with similar tourism demand.
